title: Unbounded Array/Map Length Allocation in Canonical CBOR Parser
description: Malformed or hostile CBOR payloads specifying an integer array or map count exceeding buffer bounds caused Vec::with_capacity panic (capacity overflow), enabling remote denial of service.
remediation: Enforced bounds checking that array count <= remaining buffer bytes and map count <= remaining bytes / 2. Added recursion nesting depth ceiling of 64.
